rules.batch_unlock: A batch may start only after every module in the previous batch is accepted and reconnected to the same integration commit.
rules.module_acceptance: implementation or explicit blocker; commit; contract; tests; security summary; rollback note; next step.
rules.no_fake_success: Mocks, fixtures and missing sources are recorded as synthetic or blocked, never as live campus success.
rules.release_boundary: Hermes completes through batch 8 and prepares a candidate. Codex owns batch 9 review, merge, tag and Release.
rules.batch_state: Zero or more accepted batches, exactly one ready at the first unfinished batch, then locked. All accepted is legal only when the version is complete. Serial gates 1, 8 and 9 remain single-module serial batches.
